title: Time of emergence by season at Uppsala
question: Per season: warming_c (1996–2025 minus 1850–1900) over base_sd_c, and the share of recent seasons warmer than any baseline one.

issues.text: The trend mixes global warming with the town's growth and station changes; the series is not homogenised.
issues.fix: Repeat at a rural GHCN-D station nearby (or use SMHI's homogenised Uppsala series) before reading the size of the warming as global.

issues.text: Seasons are averages of ~90 days with gaps; σ comes from 51 baseline years with some missing.
issues.fix: Check that dropping seasons with fewer than 85 days changes S/N little.

alternatives.question: Do daily maxima (TMAX) show the same seasonal order of emergence?
alternatives.why: Drills into the other half of the day; nights warm faster in towns.

alternatives.question: Has the signal emerged earlier at a rural station than in Uppsala?
alternatives.why: Expands to a second station to separate the urban part of the trend.

hypotheses.statement: Recent summers (JJA) lie further above their pre-industrial mean, in units of σ, than recent winters (DJF).
hypotheses.null: The z of recent summers equals that of recent winters.

hypotheses.statement: Winter warmed at least as much as summer in °C.
hypotheses.null: Winter's anomaly is smaller than summer's.

concepts.label: Season
concepts.description: DJF, MAM, JJA, SON per season_year.

concepts.label: Warming signal
concepts.description: Season mean daily minimum minus its 1850–1900 mean, °C.

data.request: GHCN-D daily TMIN of a rural station near Uppsala with a long record
data.why: Separates the urban heat island from the regional warming.

method.summary: Mean z of the 1996–2025 seasons, summer against winter, with the uncertainty of each mean.

steps.title: The station's record
steps.detail: csv/by_station/SWE00139148.csv from s3://noaa-ghcn-pds, TMIN without quality flags (tmin).

steps.title: Seasons
steps.detail: season and season_year from the month (December with the next winter); seasons with ≥ 80 days (seasons).

steps.title: Baseline and noise
steps.detail: Mean and σ of 1850–1900 per season; warming and S/N (emergence).

steps.title: Anomalies in σ
steps.detail: anomaly_c and z per season-year (anomalies); compare the recent z by season.

steps.title: Emerged or not
steps.detail: S/N above 2 and most recent seasons above the baseline's warmest: emerged.

caveats: Not homogenised: station moves and instrument changes are in the trend.
Urban heat island: Uppsala's growth warms its nights.
σ from about 50 baseline years is itself uncertain by ~10%.
